title: What is Council City?
question: What is Council City?
answer: Council City is the public governance surface where the Council of AI renders measured state as a live, browsable town. Each district in the town maps to one board: a measured capability axis with a named gate status and a signed board manifest behind it. The point of the metaphor is legibility over hype. Instead of a buried benchmark spreadsheet, you get a street map you can walk: every district is either measured and gated, still being measured, or explicitly not promoted. A verified measurement credential is the passport into the town, and the whole map is rendered from signed data, not from prose claims you have to take on faith. The dated hook here is the 2026-08-14 build: districts with a measurable gate are displayed, and anything not yet measured stays visibly empty rather than being quietly filled in.
ref: Council of AI — Council City governance surface series (2026-08-14 build)
